card: This pull request adds an accessor function to expose the transaction version field in the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper. Currently, external consumers of libbitcoinkernel must manually slice and inspect serialized bytes to access the transaction version. The PR adds btck_transaction_get_version alongside existing accessors like locktime and input counts, accompanied by unit tests across several transaction versions.
evidence: Author description: "It completes the existing set of transaction accessors allowing clients to read the transaction version without slicing serialized bytes."
problem: Downstream consumers of libbitcoinkernel cannot read a transaction's version through the public API without manually slicing and decoding serialized transaction bytes.
scope_notes: Small API addition with C and C++ wrappers and unit tests.
summary: Expose the transaction version field in the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper. The new function btck_transaction_get_version returns CTransaction::version directly from a btck_Transaction pointer.
